faqs.question: What is the Chemspeed FLEX ISYNTH used for?
faqs.answer: It's a fully automated, modular chemistry platform for materials library synthesis and crystallization optimization, running reaction preparation, synthesis, work-up, analysis, and storage transfer in one integrated workflow.

faqs.question: How much can it improve lab efficiency?
faqs.answer: Chemspeed states the platform enhances efficiency and productivity by a factor of up to 100.

faqs.question: What reaction scale does it support?
faqs.answer: μL to mL, using disposable, high-precision glass reactor arrays.

faqs.question: How many parallel reactions can it run?
faqs.answer: 24, 48, 96, or more parallel reactions per run, depending on configuration.

faqs.question: What unit operations can the reactor arrays perform?
faqs.answer: Mixing (shaking up to 1,000 rpm), heating (up to 150°C), cooling (to -20°C), reflux, vacuum, inertization, evaporation, liquid/liquid extraction, filtration, solid-phase extraction, crystallization, and drying.

faqs.question: Does it include structural analysis capability?
faqs.answer: Yes, integrated online benchtop XRD, such as Bruker D6 Phaser or Malvern Aeris, is available with a dedicated sample handover station and full integration.

faqs.question: What other analytics can be integrated?
faqs.answer: Benchtop online NMR, HPLC (MS), UPLC (MS), GC (MS), UV-VIS, and NIR/MIR/DLS measurement cells.

faqs.question: What gravimetric handling ranges does it support?
faqs.answer: Solid handling from μg to g, and liquid handling from mg to g / μL to mL.

faqs.question: What software runs the platform?
faqs.answer: AUTOSUITE for drag-and-drop experiment design, and ARKSUITE for broader lab orchestration, data, inventory, and workflow management.

faqs.question: What is the price of the FLEX ISYNTH in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the throughput, reactor array, and analytics configuration needed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the FLEX ISYNTH in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Chemspeed FLEX ISYNTH in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

faqs.question: What is the Chemspeed FLEX AUTOPLANT used for?
faqs.answer: It's an automated process R&D and preparative synthesis workstation built for high-output experimentation in developing and optimizing pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, polymers, catalysts, and energy materials, with reactors that mimic real production conditions.

faqs.question: How many reactor volumes are available?
faqs.answer: Three: 100, 240, and 1,000 mL, each individually controlled.

faqs.question: How many syntheses can run per session?
faqs.answer: Up to 6, covering reaction prep, execution, work-up, and analysis.

faqs.question: What pressure can the reactors handle?
faqs.answer: Up to 100 bar, with corresponding safety installations.

faqs.question: How different can conditions be between adjacent reactors?
faqs.answer: Up to a 130°C temperature difference, with active cooling available beyond that.

faqs.question: What viscosities can the system mix?
faqs.answer: Up to 80 Pa·s at 300 rpm, or 30 Pa·s at 900 rpm, using an anchor stirrer.

faqs.question: Can the platform monitor reactions in real time?
faqs.answer: Yes, through parallel calorimetry and viscosity data, plus PAT interfaces to pH, UV-VIS, IR, Raman, and PSD probes.

faqs.question: Does it include in-line structural analysis?
faqs.answer: Optionally, yes, integrated online benchtop NMR (80 MHz Fourier RxnLite) or integrated online benchtop XRD (Bruker D6 Phaser, Malvern Aeris) can be added.

faqs.question: Does the NMR option require liquid nitrogen or helium?
faqs.answer: No, it uses a permanent magnet design, with no liquid nitrogen or helium required.

faqs.question: What is the price of the FLEX AUTOPLANT in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the reactor configuration and optional analytics needed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the FLEX AUTOPLANT in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Chemspeed FLEX AUTOPLANT in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

faqs.question: What is Swing Sp used for?
faqs.answer: It's an automated sample preparation platform for analytics, QC, and preformulation, dispensing virtually any ingredient or compound into vials, tubes, plates, or reactors with high throughput and inherent data integrity.

faqs.question: What makes the gravimetric dispensing different?
faqs.answer: Chemspeed's patented overhead capability moves the balance to the destination rather than moving the destination to the balance, which increases speed and efficiency by removing transfer steps from every dispense.

faqs.question: What balance resolutions are available?
faqs.answer: 1 mg, 0.1 mg, or 0.01 mg, selectable according to the precision the application requires.

faqs.question: What is the dispensing range?
faqs.answer: From a few milligrams up to several grams, covering trace-level and bulk preparation on the same platform.

faqs.question: Which materials can Swing Sp dispense?
faqs.answer: Liquids, solids, powders, granulates, spheres, low-viscous and highly-viscous materials, and waxes.

faqs.question: Does the destination need to move during dispensing?
faqs.answer: No. The destination — vial, tube, plate, or reactor — stays in place while the balance moves to it.

faqs.question: What destination formats are supported?
faqs.answer: Vials, tubes, plates, and reactors, in the rack or reactor format of the user's choice rather than a fixed proprietary layout.

faqs.question: Does the system handle liquid handling as well as gravimetric dispensing?
faqs.answer: Yes. A 4-needle head provides volumetric liquid handling and sampling alongside the gravimetric dispensing capability.

faqs.question: Can the system run more than one type of workflow?
faqs.answer: Yes. The dispensing and dosing robotic tool can be combined with other tools to accommodate multiple workflows on the same platform.

faqs.question: What data does the system record?
faqs.answer: Dispensed amount, mixing speed, temperature, time, and other parameters are stored in a read-only log file.

faqs.question: Why does the log being read-only matter?
faqs.answer: A record that cannot be edited after the fact removes the question of post-hoc modification, which is what data integrity requirements in regulated environments are designed to address.

faqs.question: Which systems can Swing Sp integrate with?
faqs.answer: Interfaces are available for DOE, ML, AI, LIMS, ELN, and ERP integration.

faqs.question: Does building a workflow require programming?
faqs.answer: No. AUTOSUITE uses drag-and-drop experimentation — start from a prebuilt workflow or assemble predefined tasks into a custom application.

faqs.question: What is ARKSUITE?
faqs.answer: Software that coordinates and orchestrates laboratory workflows across any number of Chemspeed systems and manual lab processes, centralizing workflows, experiments, messaging, status, and inventory management.

faqs.question: Can Swing Sp work alongside other Chemspeed systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. ARKSUITE is built to coordinate multiple Chemspeed systems within one centralized environment, alongside manual processes.

faqs.question: What is the price of Swing Sp in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the balance resolution, tooling, rack format, and integration requirements.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of Swing Sp in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Chemspeed Swing Sp in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroHook: The balance goes to the sample. Not the other way around.
longForm.heroLead: Every gravimetric dispensing platform faces the same bottleneck: weighing means getting the vessel onto a balance. Move the plate, move the vial, move the reactor, weigh, move it back. Multiply that across a few hundred samples and the transfer steps cost more time than the dispensing does. Chemspeed's patented overhead gravimetric capability turns it around. The balance moves to the destination, so vials, tubes, plates, and reactors stay exactly where they are while material is dispensed and weighed in place. Speed and efficiency both come from removing motion nobody needed. What gets dispensed is the other half of the story. Liquids, solids, powders, granulates, spheres, low-viscous and highly-viscous materials, waxes — into whatever rack or reactor format the work calls for, at balance resolutions down to 0.01 mg and across a range from a few milligrams up to several grams. A 4-needle head handles volumetric liquid handling and sampling alongside it. And every run writes itself down. Dispensed amount, mixing speed, temperature, time and more land in a read-only log file, with interfaces out to DOE, ML, AI, LIMS, ELN, and ERP. AUTOSUITE makes building the experiment a drag-and-drop exercise rather than a programming one.

heroParagraphs: Every gravimetric dispensing platform faces the same bottleneck: weighing means getting the vessel onto a balance. Move the plate, move the vial, move the reactor, weigh, move it back. Multiply that across a few hundred samples and the transfer steps cost more time than the dispensing does.

Chemspeed's patented overhead gravimetric capability turns it around. The balance moves to the destination, so vials, tubes, plates, and reactors stay exactly where they are while material is dispensed and weighed in place. Speed and efficiency both come from removing motion nobody needed.

What gets dispensed is the other half of the story. Liquids, solids, powders, granulates, spheres, low-viscous and highly-viscous materials, waxes — into whatever rack or reactor format the work calls for, at balance resolutions down to 0.01 mg and across a range from a few milligrams up to several grams. A 4-needle head handles volumetric liquid handling and sampling alongside it.

And every run writes itself down. Dispensed amount, mixing speed, temperature, time and more land in a read-only log file, with interfaces out to DOE, ML, AI, LIMS, ELN, and ERP. AUTOSUITE makes building the experiment a drag-and-drop exercise rather than a programming one.
